critical_rules: 'Pulmonary Nodule / Mass' is a radiological opacity category, NOT histologically confirmed lung cancer.
Benign nodules (granulomas, hamartomas, tuberculomas) must NOT be labeled as cancer.
Montgomery dataset is strictly quarantined (0 images in training/validation/test).

NIH_ChestX-ray14.official_source: National Institutes of Health (NIH) Clinical Center, Bethesda, MD, USA (Wang et al., CVPR 2017)
NIH_ChestX-ray14.license_access: Creative Commons CC0 / Public Domain for biomedical research with attribution
NIH_ChestX-ray14.label_definitions: NLP text-mined from diagnostic radiology reports using NegBio and pattern-matching rules
NIH_ChestX-ray14.projections: Frontal chest radiographs (67,310 PA, 44,810 AP); 0 lateral views
NIH_ChestX-ray14.metadata_available: Data_Entry_2017.csv contains Patient ID, Findings, Age, Gender, View Position, Dimensions
NIH_ChestX-ray14.label_provenance: Automated NLP extraction from text reports (Oakden-Rayner 2020 documents 10-18% label noise)

taxonomy_compatibility.Pneumonia: Compatible with 'Pneumonia', but subject to NLP text-mining noise
taxonomy_compatibility.Nodule_Mass: Nodule (<3cm) and Mass (>3cm) map defensibly to 'Pulmonary Nodule / Mass' (NOT cancer)
taxonomy_compatibility.No_Finding: Compatible with 'Normal' after excluding follow-up scans with active thoracic co-morbidities

NIH_ChestX-ray14.potential_confounding_reduction: High: Can supply independent 2nd source for Pleural Effusion and 3rd source for Pneumonia/Nodule/Normal
known_limitations: NLP-derived labels exhibit documented 10-18% noise rate relative to board radiologist consensus
Large full archive size (~45 GB) requires bandwidth-heavy staged download
Lacks COVID-19 and Tuberculosis diagnostic categories
NIH_ChestX-ray14.no_blind_download_decision: PENDING MANUAL VERIFICATION & STAGED SUBSET ACQUISITION
NIH_ChestX-ray14.decision_rationale: High scientific value for breaking Pleural Effusion single-source reliance, but bulk download is deferred until staged sub-manifest download and label verification pipeline is active.

BIMCV_COVID19+.official_source: Valencian Region Medical Image Bank (BIMCV), Regional Ministry of Universal Health, Spain (de la Iglesia Vayá et al., 2020)
BIMCV_COVID19+.license_access: BIMCV Open Research License / Academic and non-commercial research with user registration
BIMCV_COVID19+.label_definitions: Laboratory RT-PCR molecular diagnostic test confirmation linked to regional hospital EMR and DICOM
BIMCV_COVID19+.projections: Mixed: PA, AP, Lateral, and CT axial slices (Strict filtering required: Modality == DX/CR and PatientPosition in PA/AP)
BIMCV_COVID19+.patient_id_format: Anonymized UUID session identifiers in DICOM metadata
BIMCV_COVID19+.metadata_available: Rich DICOM metadata headers, TSV session manifests, and MeSH radiological annotations
BIMCV_COVID19+.is_planar_cxr: Mixed (Contains planar CXR and CT; CT slices must be filtered out)
BIMCV_COVID19+.label_provenance: Gold-standard RT-PCR laboratory confirmation (highest clinical diagnostic reliability for COVID-19)
BIMCV_COVID19+.potential_confounding_reduction: Critical: Sole medical-grade multi-hospital European cohort capable of breaking the 100% single-source dominance of COVID-19 in LungAI
known_limitations: Requires multi-stage DICOM extraction, window leveling, and axial CT filtering
Requires academic user registration and agreement to data usage governance
Contains lateral views that must be strictly quarantined
BIMCV_COVID19+.decision_rationale: Scientifically essential to resolve COVID-19 single-source monopoly, but requires credentialed registration and projection filter validation before downloading.

TBX11K.official_name: TBX11K: Large Scale Dataset for Tuberculosis Detection and Localization
TBX11K.label_definitions: Consensus radiologist annotation panel with microbiological verification for TB
TBX11K.patient_id_format: Unique study identifier in filename stem (e.g., tb_0012, healthy_0542)
TBX11K.metadata_available: data.csv with bounding boxes, disease classification, image dimensions
TBX11K.label_provenance: Clinical panel annotation & laboratory sputum confirmation for TB
TBX11K.potential_confounding_reduction: Very High: Instantly breaks Pneumonia single-source monopoly and diversifies Normal and TB using verified local data
known_limitations: High square aspect ratio (1:1) from pre-processing requires standard letterboxing/aspect-ratio handling
TBX11K.decision_rationale: Already present on local disk with verified annotations and zero download/license risk.

VinDr-CXR_VinBigData.official_name: VinDr-CXR: An Open Dataset of Chest X-rays with Radiologist's Annotations
VinDr-CXR_VinBigData.official_source: Vingroup Big Data Institute / PhysioNet (Nguyen et al., 2021)
VinDr-CXR_VinBigData.label_definitions: Consensus annotations by 17 board-certified radiologists with bounding box coordinates
VinDr-CXR_VinBigData.label_provenance: 17 board-certified radiologists, 3 annotations per image merged via Weighted Boxes Fusion

taxonomy_compatibility.Nodule/Mass: Directly compatible with 'Pulmonary Nodule / Mass' (Option B)

VinDr-CXR_VinBigData.potential_confounding_reduction: High: Primary local source for Pleural Effusion and Nodule/Mass findings
known_limitations: Downscaled COCO version stored in local archive
Multi-label findings require filtering to prevent contradictory class assignment
VinDr-CXR_VinBigData.decision_rationale: Locally available, high diagnostic precision from 17 radiologist consensus.

JSRT.official_name: Japanese Society of Radiological Technology (JSRT) Standard Database
JSRT.official_source: JSRT & Japanese Radiological Society (Shiraishi et al., AJR 2000)
JSRT.license_access: Open Academic Use for Medical Image Processing
JSRT.label_definitions: Histologically confirmed biopsy/resection pathology for nodules; clinical follow-up for controls
JSRT.patient_id_format: Standard study ID (JPCLN001 to JPCLN154, JPCNN001 to JPCNN093)
JSRT.metadata_available: jsrt_metadata.csv with pathology, diagnosis, age, sex, nodule location, degree of subtlety
JSRT.label_provenance: Tissue biopsy histological pathology (highest surgical ground truth)

taxonomy_compatibility.benign: PURGED / EXCLUDED: 54 cases (tuberculomas, granulomas, hamartomas) must NOT be labeled as cancer

JSRT.potential_confounding_reduction: Moderate: Supplies high-integrity benchmark pathology for Nodule/Mass and Normal
known_limitations: Film-digitized CXR archive with characteristic digitization artifacts and high dynamic range
JSRT.decision_rationale: 54 benign cases purged; 100 malignant nodules and 92 normal controls retained.

Montgomery_County_CXR.official_source: Department of Health and Human Services, Montgomery County, MD, USA & NLM
Montgomery_County_CXR.label_definitions: Mycobacterial culture and clinical radiological diagnostic workup
Montgomery_County_CXR.label_provenance: County public health clinic clinical and microbiological diagnostic records
Montgomery_County_CXR.taxonomy_compatibility: Fully compatible, but strictly quarantined for external out-of-domain evaluation
Montgomery_County_CXR.potential_confounding_reduction: N/A - Reserved strictly for external testing
Montgomery_County_CXR.known_limitations: Historic film digitization with dense black non-anatomical borders
Montgomery_County_CXR.no_blind_download_decision: REJECTED FROM ALL INTERNAL MANIFESTS (STRICT QUARANTINE)
Montgomery_County_CXR.decision_rationale: Reserved 100% exclusively as pristine held-out external benchmark to prevent data leakage and benchmark contamination.
